shared_elements: vertical monolith treated as an anthropomorphic body
arm bent at the elbow rendered in low relief on the body
hand with fingers indicated, placed toward the front/centre of the body
horizontal band/belt-like line across the lower body
shallow, schematic relief motifs distributed on a flat body surface
justification: Both surfaces treat an upright stone block as a body carved in low relief with a bent arm whose hand reaches around toward the front, above a horizontal belt-like line, and both use flat, schematic, low-relief conventions with details reduced to simple contours. The clearest difference is content beyond that scheme: A carries a sculpted head with headdress motifs and a prominent central disc and paired curved elements on the chest, while B adds a profile quadruped-like animal in relief above the arm and lacks the disc and head.
